description: 3-way match: checks invoice lines against purchase order (price, quantity, unit) and goods receipts (net received quantity incl. reversals) within the connection's tolerances. Pass `lines` from an incoming invoice BEFORE booking it, or supplier_invoice + fiscal_year to check one already in SAP. Returns per line ok/reasons and the goods receipt the invoice item must reference. Read-only.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year of the supplier invoice

lines.description: Invoice lines to check before booking (PO, PO item, quantity, amount, unit)

amount.description: net amount of the line in document currency

purchase_order.description: SAP purchase order number the line refers to

purchase_order_item.description: Item number within the purchase order

supplier_invoice.description: SAP supplier invoice number to check (with fiscal_year)

name: get_sap_three_way_match
